usage: dispatch_run.py [-h] --run-dir RUN_DIR [--task-id TASK_ID]
                       [--delivery-run-id DELIVERY_RUN_ID] [--host HOST]
                       [--operation-id OPERATION_ID] [--adapter TOOL]
                       (--prompt-file PROMPT_FILE | --prompt-stdin)
                       [--intent {ordinary,assurance}]
                       [--orchestrator-family ORCHESTRATOR_FAMILY]
                       [--alias ALIAS | --task-class TASK_CLASS | --model MODEL]
                       [--role ROLE] [--risk-tier RISK_TIER]
                       [--model-override-tier {routine,substantial,crucial,terminal}]
                       [--reviewer-id REVIEWER_ID]
                       [--access-mode {read_only,worktree_write}]
                       [--worktree WORKTREE] [--effort EFFORT]
                       [--account ACCOUNT] [--timeout TIMEOUT_SECONDS]
                       [--retry-of RETRY_OF]
                       [--escalation-reason {gate_failed,review_blocked,capability,quota_or_limit}]
                       [--git-evidence GIT_EVIDENCE] [--cwd PROVIDER_CWD]
                       [--resume RESUME] [--resume-attempt RESUME_ATTEMPT]
                       [--require-session REQUIRE_SESSION]
                       [--context-ceiling CONTEXT_CEILING] [--knob NAME=VALUE]
                       [--sandbox {read-only,workspace-write,full}]
                       [--network {true,false}] [--capabilities CAPABILITIES]
                       [--add-dir ADD_DIRS] [--read-root READ_ROOTS]
                       [--allow-secrets] [--no-preface] [--fallback FALLBACK]
                       [--confidential] [--pick-reason PICK_REASON]

Own a durable run of provider attempts, including fallback and session resume.
Routing stays with cf_dispatch.py --plan-only; provider_exec runs the provider
in this process. Legacy receipts remain additive while Fabric v1 rows provide
live progress, typed terminal states, provenance, and controls.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-dir RUN_DIR
  --task-id TASK_ID
  --delivery-run-id DELIVERY_RUN_ID
                        RUN.json run_id of the delivery this lane serves
  --host HOST
  --operation-id OPERATION_ID
  --adapter TOOL, --tool TOOL
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
  --prompt-stdin        read the prompt bytes from stdin
  --intent {ordinary,assurance}
  --orchestrator-family ORCHESTRATOR_FAMILY
  --alias ALIAS
  --task-class TASK_CLASS
  --model MODEL
  --role ROLE
  --risk-tier RISK_TIER
  --model-override-tier {routine,substantial,crucial,terminal}
                        explicit special-model selection; independent of
                        lifecycle risk metadata
  --reviewer-id REVIEWER_ID
  --access-mode {read_only,worktree_write}
                        read_only (default) or worktree_write for a worker
                        that owns a worktree
  --worktree WORKTREE   Git worktree root the writer owns exclusively;
                        requires worktree_write
  --effort EFFORT
  --account ACCOUNT     Claude account label from telemetry configuration
  --timeout TIMEOUT_SECONDS, --timeout-seconds TIMEOUT_SECONDS
                        maximum provider runtime: read_only 3600 seconds,
                        worktree_write 10800
  --retry-of RETRY_OF   existing attempt id under this task, for lineage only
  --escalation-reason {gate_failed,review_blocked,capability,quota_or_limit}
                        reason for escalating retry-of
  --git-evidence GIT_EVIDENCE
                        run-owned Git evidence packet to copy into an Agy
                        attempt
  --cwd PROVIDER_CWD
  --resume RESUME       resume this run id; inherit route and controls
  --resume-attempt RESUME_ATTEMPT
                        resume from this attempt instead of the latest
  --require-session REQUIRE_SESSION
                        continue exactly this provider session; never relaunch
                        a new one
  --context-ceiling CONTEXT_CEILING
                        auto-compaction threshold in tokens, clamped to
                        100k-1M
  --knob NAME=VALUE     harness-profile override for this dispatch; repeatable
                        (provenant profile list)
  --sandbox {read-only,workspace-write,full}
  --network {true,false}
  --capabilities CAPABILITIES
  --add-dir ADD_DIRS
  --read-root READ_ROOTS
                        outside directory a read-only cwd or prompt file may
                        use; repeatable
  --allow-secrets
  --no-preface
  --fallback FALLBACK   false, true, any, or JSON route list
  --confidential        never route this task, or any fallback, to a prompt-
                        training model; a free model counts unless its entry
                        sets trains_on_prompts false
  --pick-reason PICK_REASON
                        why a route pool picked this model; appended to the
                        Route line
